reviews.author: Brijesh Somashekar
reviews.text:
After landing back in Bangalore from Pune around 11:15 PM, we headed to Empire Restaurant in Devanahalli for a late-night family dinner. When it comes to late-night dining in and around Bangalore, Empire is always a safe and reliable choice.

We reached the restaurant around 12:15 AM, and although they had already sold out of their famous biryani (which wasn't surprising at that hour!), the rest of the food was absolutely delicious. We ordered Alfaham Chicken, Pepper Chicken, Pepper Brain Fry, Parottas with Chicken Curry, and Ghee Rice. Every dish was fresh, flavorful, and served hot. The Pepper Brain Fry was excellent, the Alfaham Chicken was perfectly grilled, and the Ghee Rice was as aromatic and delicious as ever.

One thing I truly appreciate about Empire is the consistency they maintain across all their branches. Whether it's the quality of the food, the quick service, or the overall experience, they rarely disappoint—even well past midnight.

Overall, we had a satisfying late-night dinner with our family after a long journey. If you're looking for authentic Muslim-style food around Devanahalli, especially late at night, Empire is a place you can count on. Highly recommended!

I have visited several Empire restaurants across different locations over the years, but this particular outlet was quite disappointing.

The food quality was below average. I ordered Chicken Manchurian, but it was nothing close to a traditional Manchurian dish. Adding cream to a Manchurian was unexpected and completely altered the taste. The other starters were also very average and lacked flavor.

The Chicken Tikka Masala tasted more like Butter Chicken, making it difficult to distinguish between the two dishes. The Mutton Biryani was another major letdown. Honestly, I was surprised this was from Empire, as even roadside biryani tasted better.

The service was equally disappointing. We requested tissues from the waiters multiple times, but they simply ignored the request and never returned.

Overall, this experience did not match the standards I have come to expect from Empire. I hope the management takes customer feedback seriously and works on improving both the food quality and service.

Yesterday, we were traveling from Hyderabad to Bangalore and stopped at Empire near Devanahalli for dinner around 8:30 p.m. We ordered ghee rice and chicken kebab because we wanted something light.

It was a disappointing experience.

First, the AC was not working. There was also repair work going on in the kitchen, so the dining area was full of smoke. Many customers’ eyes became red and watery.

The food was not good either. The ghee rice tasted bland, like it was cooked in the afternoon. The dal served with it was stale, watery, and had a bad smell.

When we complained, the staff quickly brought fresh dal. The new dal was good – it tasted and smelled fine. The manager also apologized and said we didn’t have to pay for the ghee rice.

We were a group of 14 people, including 7 kids. If something had gone wrong with the food for the kids or others, who would be responsible? This is not a small restaurant. Many customers were there, so they should be careful about food quality and hygiene.

The manager handled the complaint well, but the overall experience was poor. I would not recommend eating here unless they fix these issues.

reviews.author: varun subramanian
reviews.text: The Empire non-veg thali is a filling and value-for-money meal with a good mix of flavours and textures. It comes with soft rice topped with a crisp papad and a flaky parotta that pairs well with the gravies, along with a mildly spiced, comforting dal that balances the heavier items. On the non-veg side, the fried chicken is crispy outside and fairly juicy inside, the chilli chicken delivers a spicy masala kick with capsicum and onions, and the chicken curry has a thick, rich gravy that works well with both rice and parotta. Portions are generous, sides and pickles add extra punch, and the lemon mint cooler was refreshing and really good, cutting through the richness of the meal. Overall, it’s slightly on the heavier side as expected from Empire, but still a satisfying and worthwhile choice for non-veg lovers when you’re really hungry.

A Must-Stop for Food Lovers Near the Airport!

Empire Restaurant in Devanahalli truly lives up to its name. Whether you're heading to the airport or just exploring the area, this place is a solid choice for delicious food and quick service. I loved the vibrant atmosphere — spacious seating, clean interiors.

The menu is extensive, but the highlights for me were the juicy grilled chicken, their signature Empire chicken kabab — absolutely mouthwatering! The biryani was fragrant and flavorful, with just the right amount of spice. Also appreciated how fast and fresh the service was, even during peak hours.

Must-tries include their ghee rice with pepper mutton masala — a rich, comforting combo that delivers bold flavor and satisfying warmth.

Generous portions, and consistent taste — Empire never disappoints. Highly recommend this location for a satisfying meal, whether you're traveling or just hungry for something hearty!

reviews.author: Subramanya Bharadwaj
reviews.text:
Here's my detailed analysis of our experience at Empire:

Positives

1. Taste: The food was enjoyable, which indicates that the kitchen maintains a good standard in flavor and quality.

2. Popularity: The restaurant seems to attract a large crowd, suggesting its reputation for good food.

Negatives

1. Service Speed: The long wait times—both for getting a table and having the table cleaned—are significant issues. Spending over two hours to get food is excessive and reflects poorly on service management.

2. Crowd Management: Being too crowded on a weekend is understandable, but this points to the need for better resource allocation to handle peak times.

3. Parking Issues: The lack of sufficient parking forces customers to park on the roadside, which can be inconvenient and risky.

4. Food Temperature: While the taste was good, the food could have been served hot for a better experience.

Suggestions for Improvement

Service Efficiency: Adding more staff or streamlining operations during peak hours would significantly enhance the experience.

Seating and Table Management: Improved management to reduce waiting time for tables and faster cleanup.

Parking Facility: Expansion or collaboration with nearby parking spaces could ease customer stress.

Food Serving: Ensuring food is served hot and fresh consistently.

Overall

While the food quality is a strong point, the overall experience is marred by inefficiencies in service and infrastructure, especially during busy times. For a better experience, visiting during off-peak hours or opting for takeout might be more convenient.

Good atmosphere, most hygienic and good taste. Value for money and you have separate family section. Ample space for dinning and parking. I had Ghee rice with chicken curry and dry chicken starter. Had tummy full.
(Momin Management)

reviews.author: mayur nath reddy
reviews.text: Empire almost never disappoints at watever time u walk in. This place on d outskirts near airport is a good choice for late nights dinner. Amazing to see such crowd even at 1 AM. Good job guys. Keep it up

reviews.author: Sachin Muddappa
reviews.text: Just like most of empire hotels this place is huge again and can seat multiple people, they have ample parking and stalls outside so that you can park, eat and go. We tried the tawa shawarma and pulpy grapes, shawarma was good and even the pulpy orange.

reviews.author: Deepak Pani
reviews.text:
Empire Restaurant in Devanahalli offers an exceptional dining experience set against an amazing location. Situated amidst picturesque surroundings, the restaurant provides a serene ambiance that enhances the enjoyment of every meal. The expansive venue not only provides ample seating but also boasts a vast area for guests to explore.

One of the standout features of Empire Restaurant is its superb food. From delectable traditional dishes to innovative culinary creations, the menu caters to diverse tastes and preferences. Each dish is prepared with meticulous attention to flavor and presentation, ensuring a memorable dining experience for patrons.

In addition to its culinary delights, Empire Restaurant prides itself on its friendly and attentive staff. The team goes above and beyond to ensure that guests feel welcomed and well-cared for throughout their visit. Their warm hospitality adds to the overall enjoyment of the dining experience.

Moreover, Empire Restaurant offers a good amount of parking space, making it convenient for guests to arrive and depart without hassle. However, it's worth noting that due to its popularity, guests may need to wait for a table, especially during weekends. Nevertheless, the wait is often worthwhile, as the dining experience at Empire Restaurant is truly exceptional.

In conclusion, Empire Restaurant in Devanahalli is a must-visit destination for food enthusiasts and those seeking a memorable dining experience. With its amazing location, superb food, huge venue, friendly staff, and ample parking, it ticks all the boxes for a satisfying culinary adventure. Despite the occasional wait for a table, the overall experience is guaranteed to leave patrons happy and content. Whether dining with family, friends, or colleagues, Empire Restaurant promises an unforgettable gastronomic journey filled with joy and satisfaction.

reviews.author: Ridhima Jaiswal
reviews.text: The food was just ok. Moreover, the waiter recommended us one of the starter saying it's their speciality (Mutton Raan) without informing us about is price. This dish was extremely expensive and not good at all. It was almost 50% of our dinner bill for 8 people.

reviews.author: Arvind Kaduskar
reviews.text:
Empire Restaurant , a nice place to have your stomach requirements fulfilled here.
Very beautiful ambience, a big and managed parking area, super quality of all types of food, may it be vegetarian OR  Non vegetarian. We had both types of members with us so could taste veg and non-veg both. The quantity supplied was also  more than sufficient. I have see first time in my life, any restaurant serving you the food as per your requirement, I mean full, half and even quarter plates for some items.
The best juice available here is red grapes juice. One must try and you will love it...
The staff is soft spoken and very attentive.
I would recommend this restaurant to all my friends in Bengaluru to have at least one dinner at this place and I am sure, you will become a regular visitor.....
Thank you Empire Management for providing us such a delicious and yummy food

reviews.author: Shubajit Saha
reviews.text: Atmosphere and service is great. Food quality and quantity is not upto the mark. The shwarma can be eaten in 2 bites. The biriyani had a strange smell. Restroom was clean.

reviews.author: Pranav Raj
reviews.text: I would recommend it for mostly Non-vegetarian as there are very few options available for vegetarians. No Tea available, Paneer is the only option in veg curries. Irrespective of whatever paneer you order , you will get same gravy taste. I like the environment, it's on the highway with ample parking space. Close to shell petrol pump ⛽. Overall nice experience with family & friends.

reviews.text: Food quality is poor. Dont expect food as per ambience.Restroom facility and parking is Good.Better to find out other restaurants in this highway.Worst experiance.

reviews.author: DIBYASWARUP
reviews.text:
I was extremely happy to see their service and food. Though people have complained about the quantity, I couldn't find any. The quantity for the price was justified. The taste was also nice. The grilled chicken was awesome. It was tender and juicy.  We had a great time there.
As the world cup cricket was going on, I won a sipper via a scratch card. It was a happy surprise for me.

reviews.author: Life In
reviews.text:
Chicken Biryani was a joke - No it’s not a chicken biryani 🤣

Hyderabad chicken gravy too watery.

Ghee rice was amazing

Masala papad - made vaguely with large chunks of onion 🧅

Parotha was amazing 🤩

Veg biryani was sort of pulao but way better than so called chicken biryani

Oil kabab was nice

reviews.author: Abhi Das Android
reviews.text: It's a big restaurant in Devanahalli, Good for non-veg food. We ordered Chicken grill, chicken kebab boneless, ghee rice and bitter chicken. All the food we ordered were delicious. Good number of cars can be parked in their parking lot. The service was good. Bathrooms were clean. There might be waiting time during holidays and weekends.

reviews.author: Kishore Reddy S
reviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of dining at this exceptional hotel and it left a lasting impression. From the moment I stepped in, the warm welcome by attentive staff set the stage for a memorable experience.
Whether you're a food enthusiast seeking exquisite flavors or simply looking for a hassle-free dining experience with convenient parking, this hotel is a top-notch choice. I wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone seeking a culinary adventure coupled with exceptional service.
Kudos to the entire team for creating such a remarkable dining destination.

reviews.author: Nilesh Raj
reviews.text: Good food as empire always offers same price as every outlet and ambience is just awesome. This is the best place in the entire highway to crash for delightful food options. Abundant of parking and awesome lighting
